_meta.description: CP3 full-rubric residual audit judgments. Contains independent confirmations of the 24 known-open residual P1s and any NEW findings discovered by the exhaustive linguistic pass. Entries not present here that are in the residual roster are dispositioned 'clean' (full-rubric read, AI pass) by the CP3 generator.
_meta.method: AI full-rubric linguistic read (grammar/calque, POS/morphology, semantic/pedagogical fidelity, repeats). NOT native-speaker review; labelled as an AI pass, consistent with docs/G4A_UKRAINIAN_QA_FINDINGS.md.
_meta.reviewed_status: COMPLETE: 24 known-open independently confirmed; all 983 clean-pool entries read across 4 batches (SB-0001..SB-1784 residual)
_meta.pos_bar: P1 POS mismatch = gloss states a standalone WRONG-word-class sense (e.g. adj 'net' -> noun 'Залишок'). Predicate/relative descriptive glosses for adjectives (e.g. 'fragile'->'легко ламається') are standard lexicography and dispositioned CLEAN. This bar is applied consistently across the whole residual pool and explains the density divergence from the PR#7 n=48 sample (48% P1).
_meta.depth_caveat: Exhaustive full-rubric AI read at careful screening depth. Reliably catches grammatical breakage, structural/fragment defects, calque markers, POS word-class mismatches, and salient semantic/sense errors. It is an AI pass, NOT native-speaker review. Observed clean-pool defect density (1 new P1 + 7 P2 in 983) is far below the PR#7 n=48 sample rate (23 P1 / 48 = 48%). This divergence is reconciled two ways and flagged for human adjudication: (a) a consistent principled POS bar treats predicate/relative adjective glosses (e.g. fragile->'легко ламається') as CLEAN, whereas several PR#7 POS 'P1's are, under that bar, borderline/P2; (b) residual risk that AI screening depth misses some subtle sense errors of the boundary->'розташування' class. Consequently the clean pool is NOT asserted defect-free; deeper/native semantic review remains advisable and G4-A is NOT a PASS.

SB-0009.rationale: definitionUa ends with dangling purpose-clause fragment 'щоб збільшити швидкість' appended to two finished glosses; grammatically a fragment, not a definition.

SB-0191.rationale: 'формування в клас' is a malformed calque; Ukrainian would be 'формування класів'/'розподіл на класи'.

SB-0295.rationale: 'Від високої вартості' is a malformed prepositional fragment used as a definition head for an adjective.

SB-0363.rationale: 'Гірше рости' ('to grow worse') is a malformed/calqued gloss for deteriorate; should be 'погіршуватися'.

SB-0371.rationale: 'бути різницею' is a calque of 'to be the difference'; malformed Ukrainian construction.

SB-0467.rationale: Run-on, malformed establishment list ('...постійна організація, бізнес або сила...'); 'сила' is an off gloss and the list is grammatically awkward.

SB-0724.rationale: Malformed word order: trailing 'разом' dangles at the end of the definition.

SB-0058.rationale: For noun 'ally', gloss includes adjective/participle 'асоційований' as a synonym; POS mismatch.
SB-0058.independent_severity_note: independent severity P2: an extra adjective synonym in a noun gloss; mild.

SB-0306.rationale: Relative-pronoun agreement error 'Щось або хтось, який' (should be 'що'); morphology/agreement defect.
SB-0306.independent_severity_note: independent severity P2: this is a relative-pronoun agreement (grammar) issue rather than a POS mismatch.

SB-0498.rationale: Adjective 'fatal' defined with a noun head 'Заподіяння' ('the causing'); should be adjectival (смертельний/згубний).

SB-0749.rationale: Adjective 'medieval' defined starting with the noun 'Середньовіччя'; POS mismatch.

SB-0797.rationale: Adjective 'net' defined with noun head 'Залишок' (remainder); POS mismatch.

SB-1635.rationale: Adjective 'comprehensive' defined with finite verb 'покриває' (3sg 'covers'); should be adjectival.
SB-1635.independent_severity_note: independent severity P2: 'Широко або повністю покриває' is a predicate-style gloss (cf. clean 'fragile'->'легко ламається'); a defect but borderline, not a hard word-class mismatch.

SB-1695.rationale: Plural headword 'guidelines' glossed with singular 'правило/принцип'; number mismatch.
SB-1695.independent_severity_note: independent severity P2: singular/plural (number) issue, milder than a word-class mismatch.

SB-1707.rationale: Singular 'prospect' defined with plural 'Потенційні речі'; number/morphology mismatch.
SB-1707.independent_severity_note: independent severity P2: singular/plural (number) issue, milder than a word-class mismatch.

SB-1731.rationale: Adjective/participle 'confined' glossed with infinitive phrase 'Не вільно рухатися'; POS mismatch.
SB-1731.independent_severity_note: independent severity P2: 'Не вільно рухатися' is a predicate-style gloss for a participial adjective; borderline rather than hard POS mismatch.

SB-1735.rationale: Adjective 'devoted' glossed with noun phrase 'Сильна емоційна прив'язаність' + infinitive 'любити'; POS mismatch.

SB-0142.rationale: 'розташування' (location/arrangement) is wrong for boundary; boundary is a line of division ('поділу/межа').

SB-0571.rationale: 'Договір' (a contract) is wrong for harmony; harmony = 'співзвуччя/злагода'.

SB-0647.rationale: Defining trait 'говорить про вчені питання' (merely talks about learned matters) misrepresents 'intellectual'.

SB-0840.rationale: Includes off-sense verbs 'переглядати/направляти' for oversee; oversee = наглядати/контролювати.

SB-1211.rationale: 'Листя ... культивують' says leaves (not plants) are cultivated; plants are cultivated, leaves harvested.

SB-1464.rationale: Falsely frames philosophy as seeking truth 'а не через емпіризм' (opposed to empiricism); empiricism is itself a philosophical stance.

SB-1015.rationale: learner-facing ua 'отримати' is too generic and omits the essential back/recover direction that definitionUa supplies; ua conflicts with definitionUa.

SB-0067.rationale: definitionUa 'в розвіваються шатах' is ungrammatical: finite verb 'розвіваються' where an attributive participle ('розвіяних/розвіюваних') is required.

SB-0024.rationale: noun 'activation' led with an infinitive-verb phrase 'Робити активними та ефективними'; a correct nominal gloss follows, so partial POS inconsistency.

SB-0070.rationale: 'appealing' (attractive) led with 'Наявність апеляції' (presence of a legal appeal), a wrong-sense calque; correct 'привабливий' follows.

SB-0014.rationale: 'accordingly' primary gloss 'У природній послідовності' (in natural sequence) is a dubious archaic sense; core sense 'отже' present.

SB-0474.rationale: 'exceptional' led with awkward calque 'Формування винятку' (formation of an exception) and ends with number-disagreeing plural adj 'рідкісні' (should be sing. 'рідкісний'); core sense 'незвичайний' present.

SB-0493.rationale: 'facilitate' glossed 'Зробити легко' uses adverb 'легко' where 'зробити легким/полегшити' is required; 'або легше' is fine.

SB-0659.rationale: definitionUa carries a stray editorial artifact '[з в]' leaked into learner-facing text.

SB-1081.rationale: definitionUa uses the mild russianism/calque 'в якості примусової праці' (в качестве -> в якості); idiomatic Ukrainian prefers 'як примусову працю'/'у ролі'. Corroborated by the CP2 mechanical calque detector.
